artworks.title: River Bank in the Vale of Neath
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky bank by a body of calm water. There is no distinct horizon visible. The cluster of rocks and vegetation is the central focus. Tree roots and branches extend from the rocky surface into the water, with some reflections visible. The color palette is muted sepia, creating a vintage feel. The foliage and rocks form a detailed composition, with ripples and reflections on the water adding depth and calmness.

artworks.title: Donemark Mill near Bantry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a stone building with a waterwheel to the right. A stream of water flows down from a trough onto the waterwheel. Trees line the left side of the scene, and rocks are visible at the base of the structure. The photo has a vintage aesthetic with a sepia tone. The color palette includes warm browns and faded greens.

artworks.title: Monastery of Mar Saba
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged terrain with ancient structures built into the side of a rocky hill. The perspective is straight-on, offering a detailed view of the architecture clinging to the cliff face on the right. The horizon is high as the hill and buildings rise, with tall towers reaching towards it. The color palette is a monochromatic sepia tone, highlighting the texture of the rocks and structures. In the distance, the rocky landscape continues, with some arid vegetation scattered across the terrain.

artworks.title: The Street called Straight, Damascus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Charles T. Isaacs
artworks.description: This image shows a large stone archway leading into a narrow cobblestone street. The viewpoint is right in front of the arch, looking into the passageway. The walls and arch frame the view, not showing the horizon. The passageway curves to the left and is surrounded by closely packed, slightly aged buildings with wooden beams and irregular arches. The photo is in sepia tone, giving it an antiquated look with browns and soft yellows emphasizing the historic ambiance.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Dr. Charles T. and Alma A.  Isaacs
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing turned to their left. They are wearing a veil covering most of their face except for the eyes. The person has fabric draped over their head, and their hair is not visible. They are dressed in a robe-like garment with long sleeves made of light-colored fabric. Their hands are visible clasping the garment in front of them. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a plain wall with texture, and they are standing on a tiled floor. The photograph has an aged appearance with discoloration and marks around the edges.

artworks.title: Pyramid of Cheops, Giza
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a pyramid from a slight upward angle. The pyramid stands out prominently against the sky. The horizon is low in the frame, with the pyramid dominating the view. The surroundings appear to be sandy or stony mounds. The image has a sepia tone, giving it an aged look. The color palette is primarily brown and beige, emphasizing textures and creating a warm feel.

artworks.title: At Winterdyne on the Severn
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Charles T. Isaacs
artworks.description: The image is captured from a ground-level point of view, looking down a winding path surrounded by dense trees and foliage. The path disappears into the distance, with no clear end in sight. The photograph is monochromatic, akin to early photography, creating a sepia-toned effect. Greenery and tall trees line the path, casting shadows, while three figures in light clothing sit at the edge of the path. The composition and color palette of the image give a serene, timeless nature scene.

artworks.title: Study of Foliage
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a view from above of a wooded area. Various vegetation, including shrubs and bushes, is visible in detail. Tall trees dominate the scene, silhouetted against a light sky. The horizon is obscured by trees and hills, creating a layered effect. The trees and hills blend into the light sky. The image is sepia-toned, creating a warm, vintage look. The focus is on texture and contrast between the foliage and the sky.

artworks.title: Colosses de Memnon à Thèbes (Colossi of Memnon at Thebes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows two colossal seated statues of pharaohs. The statues are weathered and worn, with some parts missing or eroded. They are made of stone and have a dark, earthy color. The statues depict seated figures facing forward with their hands resting on their knees in a regal pose. In front of the statues, there are smaller human figures, emphasizing the statues' massive size. The setting is arid with flat terrain and hills in the background.

artworks.title: Richmond, the Star and Garter
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image is an elevated view of a grand garden terrace with sculptures and manicured plants, featuring a circular design. The terrace is white and contrasts with the greenery. In the distance, a river winds through a parkland with trees. The horizon is misty, creating a soft transition to the untamed areas. The color palette is sepia tones with shades of brown and cream.

artworks.title: "The Letter"
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: Three women are depicted in the image, standing against a stone wall. The woman on the left is seated while the middle woman adjusts her neck scarf. The woman on the right is standing and holding a cloth. All three women have neatly arranged hair and wear headscarves, striped skirts, and blouses. The middle woman also wears a dark cloak. The seated woman wears shiny shoes. The background features a stone wall with visible textures and a cobblestone floor, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Ruins of Cliff Dwellings, Canyon de Chelly
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This image displays ancient cliff dwellings nestled against a towering rock face. The scene features the grandeur of the cliff, which forms a natural shelter for the structures, casting shadows over them. Rocks and sparse vegetation are scattered on the ground, indicating a rugged, arid environment. The cliff dwellings showcase intricate stone constructions rising in layers. The rock displays horizontal natural striations, enhancing the sense of motion across the sandstone surface. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes the textural contrast between the rough stonework and the smooth canyon wall, evoking a timeless and monumental quality.

artworks.title: At the Close of the Day, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of miners outside the entrance of a mine. The men's full bodies are visible, with some standing and others crouching or leaning. They wear work attire typical of miners, including dark, heavy clothing suitable for labor in the mine, with some having soot on their faces, indicating their profession. Their heads are adorned with hats, some with lamps attached. Several of the men are holding metal lunch pails. The background of the image consists of a wooden structure, presumably the entrance to the mine, with a metal rail track leading into the depths. Steam or smoke is visible in the background. On the sides, there are wooden barriers that partially obstruct the view inside the mine.

artworks.title: Durham Cathedral in Winter
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a cathedral with twin towers, a river, and snow-covered buildings. The cathedral towers over the scene, viewed from a low angle. The background contains rooftops meeting the sky, with a river reflecting the buildings. A snow-covered structure is near the water. The landscape is covered in snow, with sepia tones giving an old-fashioned feel. The cathedral spires reach towards the sky, surrounded by snow-covered trees. A bare tree branch frames the scene on the left.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman, visible from the waist up. She has dark, neatly parted hair. She wears a long-sleeved, dark dress with a high collar and white lace or frilled trim at the cuffs. She is posed with her right elbow on a table and her right hand under her chin, with her left hand resting on her lap. There is a small object in her left hand. A dark, round table nearby holds a book or box. The background is plain and the scene is framed in gold.

artworks.title: Waterfall, County Wicklow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a waterfall cascading over rocks. A man is sitting on a rocky ledge near the waterfall, which flows into a pool of water. In the background, there is a mountain, a sky with clouds, and dense foliage. The image is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Farm Yard, Prestbury near Cheltenham
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image captures a rustic barn with stone walls and thatched roofs in a yard. A small pond with a stone edge is nearby, with a wooden wheelbarrow on the grass. The horizon, almost obscured by the roofs, features a couple of chimneys. The photo has a sepia tone, with a color palette of brown, tan, and muted grays. Sparse branches from a tree reach towards the upper left.

artworks.title: Queen Victoria and Children
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Lion Fountains at the base of the Capitoline Ramp, Rome
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a lion in a reclined stance, with its head raised and front paws stretched out in front. The sculpture is crafted from a weathered dark stone material and placed on a rectangular stone pedestal in a paved area. In the background, stone steps ascend, complementing the classical aesthetic of the scene.

artworks.title: The Upper Lake, Penllergare Valley Woods
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a pathway winding through a wooded area. The perspective is from a point along the path looking forward as it disappears into the lush scenery. There is no visible horizon, as the eye is led further along the path into the foliage, where trees obscure the view. The scene is captured in black and white. The trees on either side of the path have dense foliage, with trunk textures and leafy vines visible. Light filters through the treetops, creating dappled shadows on the path and adding depth to the image. A bridge in the distance suggests a continuation of the path.

artworks.title: The Upper Falls, Penllergare Valley Woods
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall surrounded by trees. Looking up from a lower angle, the waterfall is framed by branches forming an arch. The image focuses on the waterfall and surrounding foliage, with the rocks beneath it directing the flow of water smoothly. The color palette consists of sepia tones, blending various shades of brown. Green trees near the waterfall add depth, while sunlight filtering through the leaves highlights the natural elements.

artworks.title: A Summer's Evening, Penllergare
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with trees lining the banks, a rowboat moored close to the right bank, and the water fading into mist in the distance. The horizon is high, and the color palette is sepia, creating a serene and timeless quality to the image.

artworks.title: El Palacio de las Palomas, Uxmal (The Palace of the Pigeons, Uxmal)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a view from slightly above ground level displaying an ancient linear structure made of pyramid-like stone shapes, some covered with plants. An archway stands prominently among the formations. Figures in white clothing and hats are scattered among dry vegetation, with a pile of stones on the left. The scene has a sepia tone, creating an antique feel.

artworks.title: Nude Study
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
